## isaac-mcp
You are working in isaac-mcp (NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab via MCP, 15 tools).
Before starting work: call sim_status() for Isaac/GPU state; scenes in scenes/ (.depot/registry.json); jobs in jobs/{id}/ (state.json, control.json, stop.signal).
Drive sims with load_scene/start_sim/get_state/apply_control/list_jobs; use natural_language_control for NL actuator commands.
At end of work: ruff check + pytest -q green, commit in <=5-file batches, never commit .env.
